sections.title: Getting Started
sections.text: To begin, drag and drop an image or click the central button to select a file from your device.

sections.title: Canvas Controls
sections.text: Use the zoom buttons or mouse scroll to zoom in and out. You can also move the image by dragging with the right mouse button.

sections.title: Tools Overview
sections.text: Choose a tool from the left panel. You can crop, rotate, flip, resize, and apply basic color adjustments.

sections.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
sections.text:
• Ctrl + Z: Undo
• Ctrl + E: Export image
• + / -: Zoom in/out
• Esc: Close modals or deselect tools

sections.title: Exporting Images
sections.text: Click the Export button in the left panel to save your edited image. You can choose the format and file name.

sections.title: Interface Customization
sections.text: Switch between light and dark mode via the settings panel. You can also change language and reset panel sizes there.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.text: If something doesn’t work as expected, try refreshing the page. You can also contact support or check the FAQ section.

sections.title: Need More Help?
sections.text: For more detailed documentation, visit our support page or reach out via support@example.com.
